text: PaXExpandInEpsilon is an option for PaXEvaluate. If ImplicitPrefactor is not 1 and SubstituteEpsilon is set to True, then the value of PaXExpandInEpsilon determines whether the final result should be again expanded in Epsilon.
The expansion is done only up to \mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^0). The default value is True.
